source_summary.source: Official WaterTAP ASM1 flowsheet and property/reaction packages
source_summary.configuration: All R5 effluent passes through CL1; only CL1 underflow RAS is returned, with the existing waste-sludge purge retained.
source_summary.evidence_boundary: Steady-state ASM1 surrogate with ideal component-split clarifier. Aeration electricity is an explicit post-processing estimate from native oxygen transfer using 1.8 kg O2/kWh; it is not a blower model. No phosphorus, settling dynamics, or equipment costing is represented.
